title: GrantThai profile.yaml
description: Draft (structure only). profile.yaml is an OPTIONAL, local, user-owned editor convenience, never committed (.gitignore). `grantthai init` and the offline webform may read it to pre-fill PROFILE.* fields in project.yaml at authoring time (the values are copied into project.yaml). `grantthai build` and every other command that produces output NEVER read profile.yaml — see spec/contracts/one-input-one-output.md. Roles here are UX defaults only. derived_from: core/02@sha256:d36e6922a01296bd5001733ca7d5e1d2f6927fbcc08ffebde176d0d2159535a4 (group 00 fields), amended per docs/design/PLAN.md §B ('Registration').

person_id.description: Locally generated, not a server account id.

roles.description: UX defaults only, never permissions. See spec/common/roles.yaml.

institution.description: Institution is a record, not a person.
